_readme: A filer that re-registered under a new CIK keeps its earlier XBRL periods under the old one; scripts/build-fundamentals.mjs merges the old companyfacts under the new (api/_lib/secFundamentals.js mergeFacts) so the trailing four quarters can span the change. Keyed by ticker; cite the source.

XOM.source: SEC: the 2026-Q2 10-Q is filed by ExxonMobil Holdings Corp (CIK 2115436); the periods through 2026-Q1 are Exxon Mobil Corp's (CIK 34088).
